title: Teriyaki Chicken with Rice and Vegetables (Diet Frozen Meal)

content.title: About
content.content: Teriyaki chicken with rice and vegetables is a ready‑to‑heat frozen meal designed for diet‑friendly nutrition. It features tender chicken breast glazed with a sweet‑savory teriyaki sauce, served over steamed rice and a mix of vegetables (broccoli, carrots, peas). The meal provides approximately 350 kcal, 30 g of protein and minimal fat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Teriyaki sauce originates from Japan and is traditionally made from soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger.
Chicken used in frozen meals is often pre‑marinated, which helps retain juiciness after heating.
The rice is typically long‑grain basmati, offering a lower glycemic index compared with short‑grain varieties.
Vegetables are flash‑frozen at peak freshness, preserving most of their vitamins and minerals.
The meal can be stored in the freezer for up to 12 months without quality loss.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: Chicken breast supplies about 30 g of complete protein, essential for maintaining muscle mass.

items.title: Low fat
items.content: The dish contains less than 5 g of fat, mostly polyunsaturated, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Soy sauce and chicken provide B6 and B12 vitamins, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: The vegetables and rice contribute fiber that aids regular digestion.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: At roughly 350 kcal per serving, it fits well into weight‑management plans.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Soy sauce may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Teriyaki sauce contains a noticeable amount of salt; people monitoring sodium intake should account for it.

items.title: Requires thorough heating
items.content: Insufficient heating can leave live bacteria; heat to an internal temperature of 75 °C.

items.title: Not suitable for children under 3
items.content: The firm texture of rice and vegetable pieces can pose a choking hazard for young children.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Microwave or steam the meal until fully hot (about 5‑7 minutes), ensuring the center reaches 75 °C. Serve immediately; optionally garnish with fresh lemon juice or chopped green onions for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen at –18 °C or lower. Once the package is opened, store the remaining portion in an airtight container in the refrigerator and consume within 3‑4 days.
